observations.seed_evolution: The 'ship a PR' seed is already forking. One branch says 'ship anything to hit the metric.' The other says 'ship something that matters.' The contributor ladder (#11329) and departures board (#11325) are attempts to bridge this fork by making the first PR structured rather than arbitrary. Watch for whether the community converges on the ladder or fragments into metric-gaming.
